description: Source code for managing a mesh client table with hash-based storage, including functions for adding, deleting, finding clients, and iterating over the client list.

methods.name: HashMe
methods.description: Generates a hash index based on MAC address and interface type.

methods.name: HashFree
methods.description: Frees a hash item by clearing its memory.

methods.name: HashAlloc
methods.description: Allocates a new hash item from the pool.

methods.name: HashFind
methods.description: Finds a hash item by interface and MAC address.

methods.name: HashAdd
methods.description: Adds a new client to the hash table.

methods.name: HashDelete
methods.description: Removes a client from the hash table.

methods.name: Mesh_ActiveClientCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of active clients.

methods.name: Mesh_UpdateClientTable
methods.description: Updates the client table with connect or disconnect request.

methods.name: DumpHashStats
methods.description: Outputs statistics about hash table buckets.

methods.name: DumpClientTable
methods.description: Outputs the current client table contents.

methods.name: Mesh_ClientTableIterInit
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for traversing the client table.

methods.name: Mesh_ClientTableIterNext
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next client in the table.
